task.text:
How might the following information be used to solicit a potential customer?

Sales performance of a new product

attempts.high: I do marketing copy for a funeral home and we just launched a new pre-paid cremation package. How might I use the early sales numbers on it to solicit potential customers — basically older folks worried about being a burden, the angle is "don't leave your grieving family with the bill." How do I work the performance figures into that pitch?
attempts.low: I help out with marketing for our local community garden co-op and we just started selling our new beginner seed-starter kits. How might I use the early sales numbers on those kits to reach out to potential new members and get more neighbors excited about growing their own veggies?
